project_type: Two Spring Boot 4.0.5 backends (Merchant-Backend port 8120, super-merchant port 8110) sharing a PostgreSQL database with separate schemas (merchant, supermerchant, public). Cross-schema access via native SQL.
build_system: Maven 3.9+ with spotless-maven-plugin for code formatting. Uses Lombok, Spring Data JPA, and core-utils shared dependency.
test_framework: Spring Boot Test with JUnit 5 and H2 for tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run `mvn spotless:apply -B` to fix formatting. 2. Run `mvn spotless:check -B` to verify. 3. Run `mvn compile -B -DskipTests` to verify compilation passes.
environment_constraints: Both projects must remain compatible. Changes to supermerchant.pending_approvals schema require coordination. Do not push without passing spotless:check.
contribution_requirements: Use @Transactional for writes. Use native SQL (EntityManager.createNativeQuery) for cross-schema access in Merchant-Backend. Follow existing DTO patterns with @JsonProperty and Lombok @Builder.

key_patterns.merchant_backend_native_queries: See SettlementConfigController.java and BranchService.java for native query patterns. Uses entityManager.createNativeQuery() with setParameter().
key_patterns.merchant_backend_dto: DTOs use Lombok @Builder, @Data, @NoArgsConstructor, @AllArgsConstructor with @JsonProperty for snake_case JSON. No @RegisterForReflection (Spring Boot, not Quarkus).
key_patterns.merchant_backend_api_response: Controllers return ApiResponse<T>.success(data) or ApiResponse.success(data, message).
key_patterns.merchant_backend_auth: Use MerchantScope to get merchantId(). MerchantUser has name, email, phoneNumber fields.
key_patterns.super_merchant_entity: PendingApproval uses @Entity with schema=supermerchant. Fields use @JoinColumn for FK refs to Admin.
key_patterns.super_merchant_approval_dto: SettlementConfigApprovalDto.java has maker_name/maker_email fields populated by toSettlementDto() in ApprovalService.
key_patterns.bank_code_resolution: TenantScope.bankCodesForUser(userId) returns List<String> of banks that issued TIDs to a merchant. Use native query: SELECT DISTINCT bank_code FROM tids WHERE user_id = :id LIMIT 1

directory_structure.merchant_backend: Merchant-Backend/src/main/java/com/tms/report/modules/{module}/{controller,service,dto,model}/ - Standard Spring module layout. Settlement module at modules/settlement/.
directory_structure.super_merchant: super-merchant/src/main/java/com/tms/report/modules/{module}/ - Same structure. Checker module has PendingApproval model and ApprovalService. Approval module has DTOs and controllers.
